div.div: 4 ارزى إِلَيْهِ He leaned, or stayed, himself upon, or against, him, or it; and he had recourse, or betook himself, to him, or it, for refuge, protection, covert, or lodging: (K:) or أَرْزَيْتُ ظَهْرِى إِلَى فُلَانٍ I had recourse, or betook myself, to such a one for refuge, protection, covert, or lodging: (S:) or, accord. to Lth, the verb is أَرْزَأَ, with ء. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
